DB.description: D1 database for mail, users, and threads.

ATTACHMENTS.description: R2 bucket for inbound and outbound attachments.

EMAIL_PROVIDER.description: Outbound provider for the first release: `resend`.

INBOUND_EMAIL_PROVIDER.description: Set to `cloudflare` to receive through Email Routing while Resend handles outbound mail.

CLOUDFLARE_MAIL_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated domains onboarded in Cloudflare Email Routing.

RESEND_SEND_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated domains explicitly verified for Resend sending during setup.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: One-time setup key required to create the first administrator. Store it only as a Worker secret.

AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET.description: Random Worker secret used to protect authentication rate-limit identifiers.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Domain-restricted sending key from [Resend API keys](https://resend.com/api-keys). Never deploy a full-access setup key.

RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Shown once when you create the webhook at [Resend webhooks](https://resend.com/webhooks).
